newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TSUMEB STRIKE HITS GOLD FIELDS Q3 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: TSUMEB STRIKE HITS GOLD FIELDS Q3 RESULTS.

text.p: The six week strike at Tsumeb Corporation Ltd's (TCL) copper mine contributed to poor third quarter results for Gold Fields Namibia Ltd , the company said on Friday.
"The poor performance resulted from the effects during the quarter of the strike, low grades experienced at Kombat and the fall in the copper price...
"A recovery and future operating and business plan for TCL has been finalised," a statement detailing the 25.17 million Namibian dollar loss for the quarter ending September 30 said.

"Mine production at Kombat, Otjihase and Khusib is currently planned to recommence near the end of 1996. Tailings retreatment will resume at about the same time. The open pit and upper levels of the Tsumeb mine will not be reopened," the statement said.
Extensive damage was caused during the strike and the statement said an insurance claim of 25 million Namibian dollars had been approved.

"The aggressive exploration programme will continue and development through the faults at Otjihase will resume. Negotiations with the Sysmin Coordinating Unit for the loan funding of further exploration at Asis Far West are at an advantaged stage," the company said.
